title: Housing plans for Gillman Barracks and Sunset Way
asked: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre asked which parameters of the HDB housing plans for Gillman Barracks and Sunset Way remain open to change, whether site clearance or tender awards will await feedback, and whether HDB will publish its response before approving final plans or tenders.
response: Mr Alvin Tan said the plans for Gillman Barracks and Sunset Way have not been finalised and that engagement will continue beyond the 6 August 2026 consultation close. He said adjustments could be made to the development layout and the amount of greenery and heritage conserved, and that a report summarising agencies' responses to feedback and any amendments will be published. He also said HDB is not yet able to give an exact housing figure because the layout, scale and detailed design are not finalised, and that the current conceptual plan already reduces the number of homes to retain important green and heritage areas.

key_points.point: The plans for both sites are not finalised.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The plans for Gillman Barracks and Sunset Way have not been finalised.

key_points.point: Engagement with stakeholders will continue after the formal consultation period ends on 6 August 2026.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: while the formal consultation period for the Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) and Heritage Impact Assessment (HIA) ends on 6 August 2026, our engagement with stakeholders will continue

key_points.point: Adjustments could be made to the development layout and the amount of greenery and heritage conserved.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: This could involve adjustments to the development layout and the amount of greenery and heritage to conserve.

key_points.point: A report will be published summarising agencies' responses to feedback and any amendments to the original plans.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We will also publish a report summarising agencies' responses to the feedback and any amendments made to the original set of plans.

key_points.point: An exact housing figure cannot yet be given because the layout, scale and detailed design are not finalised.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We are not yet able to give an exact figure because the layout, scale and detailed design have not yet been finalised.

key_points.point: The current conceptual plan already reduces the number of homes to retain important green and heritage areas.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: in our current conceptual plan, we already reduced the number of homes to retain important green and heritage areas identified through the studies.

key_points.point: At Gillman Barracks, HDB is studying retention of most of the native-dominated secondary forest.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we are studying how to retain most of the native-dominated secondary forest within the site.

key_points.point: At Sunset Way, HDB is studying retention of a significant stretch of greenery along the former Jurong Railway Line.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: At Sunset Way, we are studying the retention of a significant stretch of greenery along the former Jurong Railway Line.

key_points.point: HDB will study designing future neighbourhoods to reduce urban heat.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: HDB will also study how to design these future neighbourhoods to reduce urban heat.

key_points.point: After 6 August 2026, further engagements will be held and study findings and feedback reviewed before detailed plans are finalised.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: After the formal consultation period closes on 6 August 2026, we will conduct further engagements with stakeholders and closely review the study findings and feedback we received before finalising our detailed development plans.

key_points.point: Alternative sites in the vicinity of both Sunset Way and Gillman Barracks were looked at, including vacant land, brownfield sites and underused sites.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we have looked in the vicinity of both Sunset Way as well as Gillman Barracks for alternative sites – vacant land, brownfield sites, underused sites.

key_points.point: Where possible, brownfield sites and vacant sites will be prioritised.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: where we can, we will prioritise brownfield sites and vacant sites

left_open: Whether site clearance or tender awards will await feedback.
Whether HDB will publish its response before approving final plans or tenders.
The exact housing yield for the sites.
Which specific parameters beyond layout, greenery and heritage remain open to change, such as footprint and mitigation.
supplementary: Supplementary questions covered ecological connectivity, alternative sites, consultation timing, EIA/HIA thresholds, urban heat, housing demand, and support for arts tenants.
